Mei (PM): Quick follow-up from last week's high-latency postmortem — we need owners and Jira tickets for the remediation items. Please claim by EOD Wed.
Devon (SRE): I'll take root-cause analysis + repro. Creating JIRA-4300 and will post bench steps.
Ravi (Infra): I can own autoscale policy tuning and canary rollout. Opening JIRA-4301. Need traffic traces to build the canary template.
Ophelia (Support): I'll own customer comms and the SLA wording. JIRA-4302. Can someone drop a sanitized example payload for verification?
Devon (SRE): Dropped trace: `s3://redwood-artifacts/pm/1759999999/trace.log` and repro command: `./run_repro --burst=45 --rps=1500`.
Mei (PM): Proposed RACI:
R: Devon (RC + repro)
A: Mei (PM) for closeout
C: Ravi, Ophelia
I: eng-oncall, analytics
Ravi (Infra): OK to that RACI. Canary plan: dev -> canary (5%) -> canary (20%) -> prod. I'll post the YAML diff and metrics to watch.
remediation-bot: Remediation checklist created: JIRA-4300, JIRA-4301, JIRA-4302. Default due-date set to 2025-05-01. Use `/remediate extend <ticket>` to change.
Mei (PM): Set due dates: Devon 2025-04-20 (RC + repro), Ravi 2025-04-24 (autoscale + canary), Ophelia 2025-04-26 (comms + SLA tests). Weekly follow-ups for 3 weeks, Thu 9am starting 2025-04-21 — I'll send the invite.
Devon (SRE): ACK. I'll add acceptance criteria on JIRA-4300: reproduces p95 spike locally, includes mitigation script, links to traces.
Ophelia (Support): ACK :white_check_mark:
Mei (PM): Summary: owners and tickets assigned; weekly check-ins scheduled. Closing claims after EOD 2025-04-10 to keep ownership stable. Ping me for deadline shifts.
remediation-bot: Thread locked for new owner claims after EOD 2025-04-10.
